title: Gate rule
description: One curriculum gate: the unit whose passing verdict clears it, what it unlocks, and whether clearing it earns a rebate.

gate_id.description: Stable gate identifier; must equal the file name stem (phase-5-integration, capstone)

title.description: Plain-language gate name shown to learners

unit_id.description: The unit whose PASSING verdict satisfies this gate (dotted pair or triple)

unlocks.description: Units that become accessible when the gate clears; empty for the final gate

rebate.description: Whether gate.pledged is emitted for this gate on first enrollment (rebate machine contract)

summary.description: What clears the gate, in one plain sentence; the learner surface shows this for locked gates
